# Typace

> Typace is a font library and font delivery service operated by The Ace Base.

## Canonical URLs

- Website: https://typace.ace-base.cc/
- Browse catalog: https://typace.ace-base.cc/browse
- Developer guide: https://typace.ace-base.cc/developers
- Font catalog API: https://typace.ace-base.cc/api/fonts
- Search API: https://typace.ace-base.cc/api/search?q=QUERY
- Individual font API: https://typace.ace-base.cc/api/fonts/SLUG
- CSS API: https://typace.ace-base.cc/api/css/SLUG
- Current deployment commit: https://typace.ace-base.cc/api/commit
- OpenAPI specification: https://typace.ace-base.cc/api/openapi.json
- Sitemap: https://typace.ace-base.cc/sitemap.xml
- Documentation: https://docs.ace-base.cc/projects/typace

## Source of truth

The live `GET /api/fonts` response is the authoritative list of published font assets. The available catalog can change; do not hardcode font names or assume every format exists for every family.

Each font record includes `name`, `file`, `type`, `format`, `category`, `url`, `createdAt`, and `updatedAt`.

- `type` identifies the file extension: `ttf`, `otf`, `woff`, or `woff2`.
- `format` is the CSS format label suitable for `@font-face`.
- `category` is only classified where supported by the font's embedded metadata. `unknown` means the file did not provide enough reliable data. It is not a quality judgment.
- `createdAt` and `updatedAt` are null when trustworthy source dates are unavailable.
- Do not infer a designer, foundry, license, glyph coverage, variable axes, weight, style, or OpenType features unless a reliable source explicitly publishes that information.

## API usage

- Fetch the catalog with `GET /api/fonts`.
- Search the catalog with `GET /api/search?q=QUERY`. Omitting `q` returns the catalog.
- Fetch one record from `GET /api/fonts/SLUG`.
- Generate a CSS declaration from `GET /api/css/SLUG`.
- Inspect the deployed commit with `GET /api/commit`, which returns the full SHA, seven-character short SHA, commit message, timestamp when available, and source. Repository URLs are intentionally omitted because the source repository is private.
- Read `GET /api/openapi.json` for the machine-readable API contract.

Use the `url` and `format` fields returned by the catalog. Do not assume every font is TTF or that every family has all file formats.

## Discovery pages

- Browse all fonts: https://typace.ace-base.cc/browse
- WOFF2: https://typace.ace-base.cc/browse/woff2
- WOFF: https://typace.ace-base.cc/browse/woff
- TrueType: https://typace.ace-base.cc/browse/ttf
- OpenType: https://typace.ace-base.cc/browse/otf
- Developer resources: https://typace.ace-base.cc/developers

These pages group published assets by format. They are not recommendation rankings. The sitemap contains canonical discovery pages rather than raw binary font URLs.

## Licensing

Each font can have separate licensing terms. Check the applicable license before commercial use, embedding, redistribution, modification, or bundling in software. Do not assume all catalog entries share one license.

## Identity

Typace is a font library and font delivery service operated by The Ace Base. Canonical website: https://typace.ace-base.cc/.
